name: The Darkmoon Faire
text: A caravan of striped tents and creaking wagons rolls into view: Silas Darkmoon's Faire has come to our lands! Games of chance, strange beasts, a fortune-teller named Sayge and a great many tickets for sale.

choices.text: Host the Faire in our capital (-100 Gold, a short Golden Age)
Try our luck at the games (-40 Gold, win up to 120)
Ask Sayge to read our fortune (+Science)

name: Plague of Undeath
text: Grain from the north has been tainted. Those who ate the bread sicken, die... and rise again. The Cult of the Damned is spreading the plague of undeath through our granaries, as it once did in Lordaeron.

choices.text: Ward the granaries with arcane seals (-25 Mana)
Burn the infected granaries (-120 Gold)
Call on the priests to cleanse the grain (-80 Faith)
Seal the gates and hope (lose population)

name: Legion Incursion
text: The sky tears open in a wound of green fire. A fel rift has opened near our lands, and the demons of the Burning Legion are pouring through!

choices.text: Stand and fight! (demons attack; heroes rise to meet them)
uniques: [2] [Felguard]s rebel <before the [Age of the Lich King]>
[2] [Infernal]s rebel <starting from the [Age of the Lich King]>

choices.text: Close the rift with a great spell (-35 Mana)
Seal the rift with arcane might (-200 Gold)

name: A Goblin Offer
text: A Steamwheedle Cartel zeppelin touches down outside the capital. A goblin in a fine suit steps out: "Time is money, friend! Have I got a deal for you..."

choices.text: Buy the goblin blueprints (-100 Gold, +Science)
Sell them our surplus grain (+Gold, lose population)
Send them packing

name: The Lunar Festival
text: The Lunar Festival has come, and the spirits of the elders walk among us. Lanterns float over the rooftops and the people ask how we will honor the old ones.

choices.text: Pay homage to the elders (+Faith)
Launch fireworks over the capital (-30 Gold, +Culture)

name: Brewfest
text: Dwarven brewers have rolled their kegs into town for Brewfest. The people are already singing, and the Dark Iron dwarves are sure to crash the party.

choices.text: Sponsor the festival (-80 Gold, a short Golden Age)
Tax the kegs (+Gold)

name: Children's Week
text: War has left many orphans in our lands. The matrons of the orphanage ask our citizens to take them in.

choices.text: Take in the orphans (-30 Gold, +1 population)
Fund the orphanage (+Culture)

name: Gnomish Refugees
text: Gnomes driven from irradiated Gnomeregan arrive at our gates with nothing but their tools and a great deal of enthusiasm.

choices.text: Welcome them into our cities (-40 Gold, +2 population)
Put them to work in our workshops (+Science)
Turn them away

name: A Titan Vault
text: Explorers' League diggers have broken into a sealed vault of the Titans. Strange machines hum in the dark, and runes glow on the walls.

choices.text: Tap the vault's power (+40 Mana)
Study the Titan relics (+Science)
Sell the relics to collectors (+Gold)
Seal it again. Some things are best left buried (+Faith)

name: The Cataclysm
text: Deathwing the Destroyer has burst from Deepholm. The earth splits, the sea rises and fire falls from the sky across Azeroth.

choices.text: Rebuild what was broken (-150 Gold)
Raise great wards against the fire (-50 Mana)
Seek the blessing of the Dragon Aspects (-100 Faith)
Endure (lose population)

name: A Wandering Brewmaster
text: A Pandaren brewmaster with a keg on his back wanders into the capital, looking for a good brew and a better story.

choices.text: Invite him to stay (-60 Gold, +Culture, +1 population)
Listen to his tales of Pandaria (+Science)

name: Hallow's End
text: It is Hallow's End, and the Headless Horseman has been seen riding by moonlight. The people beg us to light the Wickerman to keep him away.

choices.text: Light the Wickerman (+Culture)
Pay the guards to watch the night (-30 Gold, +Faith)

name: An Envoy of the Kirin Tor
text: An envoy from Dalaran offers to train our most gifted children in the arcane arts, for a fee.

choices.text: Pay the Kirin Tor in Mana (-30 Mana, +Science)
Accept the Kirin Tor's offer (-80 Gold, +Science)
Politely decline

name: Murloc Raid
text: "Mrglglglgl!" A tribe of murlocs has crawled out of the surf and is raiding our fishing villages.

choices.text: Drive them back into the sea! (murlocs attack)
Leave them an offering of fish (-25 Gold)

name: The Defias Brotherhood
text: The stonemasons who rebuilt our walls were never paid. Now they wear red masks, and call themselves the Defias Brotherhood.

choices.text: Pay the Stonemasons' Guild what it is owed (-150 Gold)
Crush the Brotherhood! (bandits attack)
uniques: [2] [Pikeman]s rebel <before the [Age of the Third War]>
[2] [Musketeer]s rebel <starting from the [Age of the Third War]>

name: The Scourge Marches
text: The Lich King's armies pour out of the north. Ghouls and death knights fall upon our borders, and the dead rise behind them.

choices.text: Hold the line! (the Scourge attacks; the faithful rally)
Hold them back with arcane wards (-40 Mana)
Burn the dead before they rise (-150 Gold)

name: The Legion Invades
text: This is no mere incursion. Fel meteors rain across Azeroth as the Burning Legion begins its invasion in earnest.

choices.text: Defend our cities! (Infernals fall; heroes rise)
Shield the cities with a great ward (-60 Mana)
Raise every ward we have (-300 Gold)

name: Whispers of the Old Gods
text: In the dark, a voice whispers. Scholars dream of tentacles and eyes, and some stop sleeping altogether. The Old Gods are stirring.

choices.text: Seal our minds with arcane wards (-40 Mana)
Resist the whispers through prayer (-100 Faith)
Silence the cultists (lose population)
Listen... (+Science, but madness spreads)

name: The Gift of Alexstrasza
text: A great red dragon circles the capital and lands in the fields. Alexstrasza the Life-Binder offers her blessing to our people.

choices.text: Accept the gift of life (+2 population)
Ask her to bless our temples (+Faith)

name: The Blue Dragonflight
text: Kalecgos of the blue dragonflight offers to share the secrets of the arcane, if we promise to use them wisely.

choices.text: Ask him to fill our Mana stores (+50 Mana)
Learn from the Spell-Weaver (+Science)
Politely decline the dragon's offer

name: Nozdormu's Warning
text: A bronze dragon steps out of time itself. Nozdormu the Timeless warns of a future that must not come to pass, and shows us how to change it.

choices.text: Heed the Timeless One (a short Golden Age)
Ask to see the paths of time (+Science)

name: The Emerald Dream
text: Our people dream of a green and endless forest. Ysera the Dreamer has touched their sleep with peace.

choices.text: Embrace the Dream (+Culture)
Let the druids interpret it (+Faith)

name: Lord Prestor's Offer
text: A charming nobleman, Lord Daval Prestor, offers gold and counsel to our court. Something about his eyes is not quite right.

choices.text: Accept his generous gift (+300 Gold, but the black dragon's influence spreads)
Unmask him! (he flees; the court is grateful)

name: A Bold Experiment
text: Our tinkers want to test a new device. In theory it will revolutionize gnomish science. In theory.

choices.text: Power it with Mana (-20 Mana, a safer gamble)
Fund the experiment (-60 Gold, a gamble on Science)
Insist on more safety tests (+Science)

name: Explosive Prototype
text: KA-BOOM! A prototype has exploded in the workshop. Nobody was hurt, probably, but the neighborhood is a crater.

choices.text: Study the crater (+Science, lose population)
Pay for the repairs (-80 Gold)

name: The Wandering Isle's Choice
text: The great turtle Shen-zin Su is wounded, and our people must choose a path. Aysa Cloudsinger and the Tushui would join the Alliance; Ji Firepaw and the Huojin, the Horde.

choices.text: Follow the Tushui and join the Alliance (defense, +10% vs the Horde)
Follow the Huojin and join the Horde (attack, +10% vs the Alliance)
uniques: Gain a free [Huojin Training Hall] [in capital]

choices.text: Remain neutral and walk the middle path (+Culture)

name: The Ley Lines Swell
text: Our Mana stores are brimming, and the ley lines beneath our cities hum with power. Our magi say such a surplus should be put to use before it slips away into the Nether.

choices.text: Channel it into research (-150 Mana, +Science)
Hold a festival of arcane lights (-200 Mana, 4-turn Golden Age)
Bless the land (-150 Mana, +Culture and Faith)
Keep the Mana in reserve
uniques: [-90]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

name: Raid: Onyxia
text: Black dragons have been seen circling our borders. The Brood Mother is hunting. Our champions are eager to raid. Do we sound the call?

choices.text: Sound the call to raid! (Onyxia rises near our lands; slay it for a Raid Trophy)
uniques: [+60]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

choices.text: Pay mercenaries to lure it elsewhere (-150 Gold)

uniques: [-80]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

text: Fel fire rains on the hills near our cities. Kil'jaeden the Deceiver walks Azeroth. Our champions are eager to raid. Do we sound the call?

choices.text: Sound the call to raid! (Kil'jaeden rises near our lands; slay it for a Raid Trophy)
uniques: [+60]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

choices.text: Pay mercenaries to lure it elsewhere (-350 Gold)

text: The sea boils and black tendrils rise from the ground. The Corruptor has awakened. Our champions are eager to raid. Do we sound the call?

choices.text: Sound the call to raid! (N'Zoth rises near our lands; slay it for a Raid Trophy)
uniques: [+60]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

choices.text: Pay mercenaries to lure it elsewhere (-410 Gold)
uniques: [-80]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

name: The Fel Offer
text: A cloaked warlock comes before our council with a chalice of green fire. 'Drink,' he says, 'and no army on Azeroth will stand against you.' The blood of demons glows in the cup.

choices.text: Drink from the chalice (+15% Strength for military units, -15% growth)
uniques: [-20]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

choices.text: Cast it down (+15% Faith, +20% Strength against raiders and demons)
uniques: [+20]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

name: The Sunwell Reborn
text: The Sunwell can burn again. The priests say it must be reborn in the Light of the naaru; the magisters say it must be rebuilt as it was, pure arcane fire.

choices.text: Rekindle it with the Light (+15% Faith, +2 Culture in the capital)
Rebuild the arcane font (+10% Science, +2 Science in the capital)

name: The Covenants Call
text: The veil to the Shadowlands has torn. Envoys of four great covenants stand before us, each asking for our allegiance in the war for the realm of death.

choices.text: Bastion's Kyrian (+2 Faith in every city, faster healing)
Revendreth's Venthyr (+15% Gold, +10% attack)
Ardenweald's Night Fae (+10% Food, +10% Strength in forests)
Maldraxxus's Necrolords (+10% Production, +10% defence)

name: A New Beginning: Humans
text: Our first city rises on the bones of Arathor, the old kingdom of men. The Light and the sword will guard it.

choices.text: Raise a militia (a free Militia)
Build a chapel (+30 Faith)

name: A New Beginning: Orcs
text: The clans have come together under one banner. Our first stronghold is raised in a land as harsh as we are.

choices.text: Sharpen the axes (a free Spearman)
Beat the war drums (+30 Culture)

name: A New Beginning: Night Elves
text: Beneath the boughs of the ancient forest, the Kaldorei found their first city in the light of Elune.

choices.text: Send the Sentinels into the woods (a free Scout)
Pray at the moonwell (+30 Faith)

name: A New Beginning: Dwarves
text: Deep in the mountains, the first halls of our kingdom are carved and the first forge is lit.

choices.text: Open the first mine (+40 Production worth of Gold)
Toast the founding (+30 Culture)

name: A New Beginning: Gnomes
text: Our first city is founded, and three gnomes have already proposed improvements to it.

choices.text: Fund the inventors (+40 Science)
Build a clockwork scout (a free Scout)

name: A New Beginning: Tauren
text: The tribes gather on the plains and raise their first great tent. The Earth Mother watches over us.

choices.text: Hunt the plainstriders (+1 population)
Speak with the spirits (+30 Faith)

name: A New Beginning: Trolls
text: The Darkspear plant their totems on new ground. The loa have shown us the way.

choices.text: Call the hunters (a free Scout)
Honor the loa (+30 Faith)

name: A New Beginning: Blood Elves
text: From the ashes of the old kingdom, the sin'dorei raise a new city of gold and crimson.

choices.text: Gather the magisters (+40 Science)
Hold a grand reception (+30 Culture)

name: A New Beginning: High Elves
text: The quel'dorei found their first city in the eternal spring of Eversong, guarded by runestones.

choices.text: Raise the runestones (+30 Culture)
Send out the Farstriders (a free Scout)

name: A New Beginning: Pandaren
text: The pandaren raise their first village among misty peaks and terraced fields. The tea is warm.

choices.text: Brew a celebration (+30 Culture)
Tend the fields (+1 population)

name: A New Beginning: Forsaken
text: Free of the Lich King's will, the Forsaken claim their first city among the ruins of the living.

choices.text: Raise the walls (+40 Gold)
Put the apothecaries to work (+40 Science)

name: A New Beginning: Draenei
text: After ages of flight across the stars, the draenei set down and build their first city. The Light has led us here.

choices.text: Pray in thanks (+30 Faith)
Salvage the crystals (+40 Science)

name: A New Beginning: Goblins
text: A new city, a new market! The first shop is already open and the prices are already high.

choices.text: Open for business (+60 Gold)
Hire some muscle (a free Militia)

name: A New Beginning: Worgen
text: Behind the Greymane Wall, Gilneas raises its first city. Whatever comes, we will face it together.

choices.text: Muster the watch (a free Militia)
Build the harvest hall (+1 population)

name: A New Beginning: Scourge
text: The cold of Northrend gathers into a will. The first necropolis rises, and the dead begin to stir.

choices.text: Raise the fallen (a free Ghoul)
Spread the plague (+30 Faith)

name: A New Beginning: Dark Iron Dwarves
text: In the shadow of the mountain, the Dark Irons light their forges. Fire is our birthright.

choices.text: Stoke the forges (+40 Gold)
Arm the guard (a free Spearman)

name: A New Beginning: Kul Tirans
text: The first city of Kul Tiras rises above a deep harbor. The sea will make us great.

choices.text: Build the docks (+40 Gold)
Bless the tides (+30 Faith)

name: A New Beginning: Zandalari Trolls
text: The Zandalari raise a golden temple at the heart of their first city. An empire begins.

choices.text: Honor the loa of kings (+30 Faith)
Gather tribute (+40 Gold)

name: The Age of Arathor
text: Kingdoms rise where tribes once roamed. Thoradin's Arathor unites the humans, and the elves teach them magic.

choices.text: Build roads between our cities (+60 Gold)
Found a school of magic (+60 Science)

name: The Dark Portal Opens
text: A rift has opened in the Black Morass and the orcish Horde pours through. The age of war has begun.

choices.text: Raise our defences (a free Spearman)
Gird our faith (+60 Faith)

name: The Third War
text: Plague in Lordaeron, demons in Ashenvale, a prince who took up a cursed blade. The world will not be the same.

choices.text: Prepare for the worst (+80 Gold)
Seek the prophet's counsel (+80 Culture)

name: The Lich King Stirs
text: Atop the Frozen Throne, the Lich King gathers his armies. Every people of Azeroth looks north.

choices.text: Forge weapons against the dead (+100 Production worth of Gold)
Call the priests (+100 Faith)

name: The Cataclysm
text: Deathwing has torn the world apart. Coastlines are drowned, mountains split and old roads gone.

choices.text: Rebuild our cities (+1 population)
Study the elemental chaos (+120 Science)

name: The Legion Returns
text: The Burning Legion has come again, in greater numbers than ever. Azeroth must stand together or burn.

choices.text: Rally every soldier (a 3-turn Golden Age)
Seek the Pillars of Creation (+150 Science)

name: The Age of Azerite
text: The world-soul of Azeroth bleeds a golden ore of terrible power, and every nation wants it.

choices.text: Mine the azerite (+200 Gold)
Heal the world-soul (+200 Faith)

name: The Void Beckons
text: Beyond the Shadowlands and the stars, the Void watches. The last age of Azeroth has begun.

choices.text: Hold to the Light (+250 Faith)
Study the darkness (+250 Science)
